name: embpw
title: Satellite embeddings 2017 (population-weighted)
description: Sixty-four satellite embedding dimensions (A00–A63) for Bolivia's 339 municipalities in 2017: the population-weighted mean, over each municipality, of the annual 10 m embeddings from the Google Satellite Embedding dataset (AlphaEarth Foundations), which summarise Sentinel-2, Landsat and other imagery. The dimensions are abstract features, designed as inputs to machine-learning models, e.g. to predict poverty.

sources.title: Brown, C. F., et al. (2025). AlphaEarth Foundations: An embedding field model for accurate and efficient global mapping from sparse label data. Google DeepMind. Earth Engine collection GOOGLE/SATELLITE_EMBEDDING/V1/ANNUAL.
Mendez, C. (2026). DS4Bolivia: A Data Science Repository to Study Regional Development in Bolivia [Data set]. GitHub.

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). Satellite embeddings 2017, population-weighted (339 municipalities). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/embpw.md
geo:notes: The dimensions are not interpretable one by one and should not be aggregated; their aggregation rule is `none`.
Computed by DS4Bolivia in Google Earth Engine on its own municipal polygons (`asdf_id`), which differ slightly from the GADM boundaries used for geo IDs.

Each pixel is weighted by WorldPop 100 m population, spread evenly over its 10 m pixels (code/aggregate-satellite-embedings-to-adm-pop-weighted1.js in DS4Bolivia), so the embeddings describe where people live. For the area-weighted version, see the `emb` dataset.

resources.name: embpw-municipality
resources.geo:source_geometry: DS4Bolivia polygons (bolivia339geoqueryFull, keyed by asdf_id), matched one-to-one to the GADM 4.1 municipalities by area overlap
